question: Should `isReplySessionInitConflictError` become a permanent public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/error-runtime` contract for channel plugins?
rationale: The shared helper removes divergent channel copies and unblocks QQBot reuse, but publishing it commits external plugins to an internal reply-session error identity and matching policy that maintainers must intentionally own.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK classifier
options.body: Keep the public export after restoring the launcher link, documenting the stable matching contract, and obtaining live channel proof.

options.title: Keep classification internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK export and centralize bundled-channel use through an internal owner seam, leaving external plugins to use a future stable error contract.

options.title: Pause for a typed error contract
options.body: Hold this PR until reply-session failures expose a stable code or typed outcome that plugins can consume without depending on message identity.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK classifier
recommendation.body: Keep the public export after restoring the launcher link, documenting the stable matching contract, and obtaining live channel proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the guarded reply-session initialization boundary and the recent merged conflict-semantics work.
